entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be monitored for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I want to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly. The heart rate monitor is completely off.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order information... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased on [date of purchase, 15 days prior]. Can you describe the issue you're experiencing?
I already told you! The heart rate isn't reading correctly! It says I'm at 40 bpm when I'm clearly sprinting! It's useless! I want my money back.

I understand your frustration. I've reviewed your purchase, and according to our return policy, the return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase. Unfortunately, it appears you are outside of that timeframe.
What? 10 days? That's ridiculous! I've been busy! I didn't have time to test it until now. This is unacceptable! I want a refund. I expect a policy exception.

I understand your disappointment. While I can't offer a full refund outside of the return window, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. This way, you can choose a different product from our range.
Store credit? So I'm stuck buying something else from you? That's…ugh, fine. It's better than nothing, I guess. What can I get with store credit?

With the store credit, you can purchase any item on our website. You could consider a different fitness tracker, apparel, or even some accessories. We have a wide variety of products available. You can also use the store credit towards any VeloFit membership options.
Okay, that's… marginally better. How does this work? How do I get the store credit?

I've already applied the store credit to your account, which is linked to your email address. When you're ready to make another purchase, simply log in and the credit will automatically be applied at checkout. You'll see it as a payment option during the payment stage.
So, I don’t need some special code or anything?

No, the store credit is automatically linked to your account. You'll just need to ensure you're logged in with the same email address you used for the original purchase. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks… actually, thank you for working with me on this. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
